meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 它会判断这次改动是 PATCH、MINOR 还是 MAJOR,把八个清单文件里的版本号一起改掉,再跑构建同步、打 git tag、建 GitHub release、重新生成 CHANGELOG,最后把 npm 发布留给你手动执行。
howto.when: 当你要给 Claude Code 插件升版本或发版时接管,例如说“升一下版本”、“发新版本”等。

say.text: 把版本升到 1.2.0 并走完发布流程
这次有破坏性变更,按 MAJOR 升版本
say.note: 它会重新判定版本级别并按 MAJOR 递增

say.text: 发布完成后帮我跑 Discord 通知
say.note: npm 校验通过后执行 discord:notify

howto.what_en: Automated semantic versioning: it decides PATCH, MINOR or MAJOR, bumps the version in eight manifest files, builds and syncs, tags, creates the GitHub release, regenerates CHANGELOG, then leaves npm publish as the final human action.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to bump the version or cut a release for a Claude Code plugin, e.g. “bump the version” or “release a new version”.

say_en.text: Bump to 1.2.0 and run the release workflow
say_en.note: Bumps manifests, tags, releases; you run npm publish

say_en.text: This has breaking changes — bump as MAJOR
say_en.note: Re-classifies the version and increments MAJOR

say_en.text: Run the Discord notification after publishing
say_en.note: Runs discord:notify once npm is verified
